descriptions.w3d_s4_choice_next: Advances an idle choice index with mode-specific wrapping, or signals the navigation boundary.
descriptions.w3d_s4_choice_previous: Moves an idle choice index backward with mode-specific wrapping, or signals the navigation boundary.
descriptions.w3d_s4_choice_update_selection: Reads a boolean or integer property into the current choice selection.
descriptions.w3d_s4_choice_cursor_changed: Refreshes an idle choice cursor property and resets its animation target.
descriptions.w3d_s4_choice_selection_changed: Refreshes an idle choice selection property and resets its secondary animation target.
descriptions.w3d_s4_choice_refresh_changed: Refreshes choice content and state when the widget is not busy.
